learning_outcomes.text: Master manufacturing processes such as foundry and stamping.
Understand the physical phenomena occurring during the shaping of metallic materials, using acquired knowledge.

syllabus_topics: Elaboration of alloys in foundry: spheroidal graphite cast iron
Method of alloy elaboration
Charge calculation
Management of material oxidation during melting
Elaboration of a spheroidal graphite cast iron
Determination of the matrix nature to be elaborated based on specifications (mechanical properties)
Charge calculation for preparing a melt bath
Elaboration of an SGI (liquid bath treatment, oxidation issues…)
Chemical composition control by spark spectrometry
Mastery of elaboration operations in real time by thermal analysis
Microstructure control with respect to initial specifications
Material/process interaction in stamping
Challenges of material mastery in stamping (Example: High-performance automotive steel)
Introduction to business simulation tools
Experimental stamping techniques and simulation calibration
Behavior tests: Ductility - Work hardening – Anisotropy
Optimization on real parts
Conduct characterization tests for a stamping operation
Process and analyze test results
Implement material behavior in process simulation software
Conduct tests on a real part
Study the impact of the process on the obtained part (especially the microstructure)
Simulate tests with a material database from the tests
Confront and recalibrate experience and simulation
